# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant (born during Volume 4)  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 c36 P41](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0041)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls Harbor, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P2](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0002), [v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit; Kit  <sub>[v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Kit weighed ten pounds at birth and possesses healthy lungs. As an infant, he is described as having hazel eyes and a high forehead like his father's, alongside his mother's large eyes and a head covered in soft, light fuzz that is expected to turn red. His small ears lie flat against his head, and he develops dimples in his elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 c34 P12](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0012), [v4 c34 P18](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0018), [v4 c35 P5](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0005)_

## Personality

As a healthy baby, Little Kit is cheerful and expressive, delighting his mother by babbling and smiling at her. He cries when carried away from his mother.

_Sources: [v4 c31 P3](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0003), [v4 c34 P14](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0014), [v4 c35 P0](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0000)_

## History

Little Kit is born in June at the small house of dreams in Seven Gulls Harbor to Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell Harcourt. His birth brings profound joy and healing to his mother following the earlier loss of his infant sister, Joyce. His grand-uncle Captain Saul, among other neighbors and friends, adores him and considers him an heir to his collection of sea curiosities. Over his first year, he grows robustly, is transitioned into short frocks, and begins making his first speech sounds.

_Sources: [v4 c34 P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c34 P27](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0027), [v4 c35 P0](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0000), [v4 c36 P41](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0041), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053)_
